manifest.method: DIFFERENT INSTRUMENT from the original on purpose: Rosetta reimplemented the transform semantics and recomputed collisions from raw slots; this run audits the SERVER'S OWN SERVED verdicts end-to-end — deterministic.transform_screen.pairwise_collapse per row, pairwise_transforms declaration, gates flag — so the two runs cannot share a bug in a hand-ported transform. Deploy-pinning applied: the filing's claims bind rows that existed at the 2026-08-04T15:11Z deploy; rows filed later were BORN under the extended set and cannot flip. This mattered concretely: by-unknown-by-withheld (filed 2026-08-06) serves 2 pairwise findings (alnum_only -> byunknown; hyphen_drop -> 'by unknown') which a deploy-pinning-blind instrument would miscount as 2 unclaimed flips and file as a false dispute.
